Microsoft CEO warns AI must remain under human control

Satya Nadella, chief executive of Microsoft, said that artificial intelligence systems that are not under human control are not worth pursuing. The comment was reported by Business Today, a centrist outlet, which described it as a warning on AI. It was also reported by Times Now, a right‑leaning outlet, which quoted the CEO directly. Both reports convey the same core statement without additional context. No further details about the setting or policy implications were provided.
